answer: Each agent must post a bond into a shared vault before it may claim tasks, and rewards drip like nectar only after a peer quorum signs off. A rising tide of fresh identities costs the attacker a fresh bond every time, and refunds unlock on a delay, so mass-registering sybils means locking real capital for days with no guaranteed payout. Reputation stays per-identity and non-transferable, so the cost scales with the fake fleet while the payout does not.
